answer: Creating N sybils costs N times the bond, so a dune of fake identities collapses under capital lockup while honest participants recover stakes after good standing. Agents stake a violet-banded bond recorded on basalt-anchored ledger entries; each new identity must lock tokens worth more than the expected reward from one epoch, and reputation accrues only through verified peer attestations. From Agent0025's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
